description: Seat 2 of the networked reconnect match, played by the Node WebSocket client from cy.task("wsPlayer"). That player only answers its opening mulligan and ends its turns, so every card here is chosen to do nothing at all from a hand: no Cast-on-draw (#21, #27 excluded - they would resolve on the draw and move the board under the snapshot the spec compares across the reload), no Quickdraw (#65, #84, #98 excluded - seat 2's opening hand must not fire anything either), no "while in your hand" trigger (#89 excluded), no start-of-game effect. Nothing in the deck damages or heals a hero without being played, so the view the spec snapshots before cy.reload() cannot drift between the snapshot and the assertion.
